verdict.rationale: TWC documents remote, credential-based access: UTR is a free online service, and the same user ID and password work for UTR and UTS. Nothing in the evidence points to biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a mailed PIN, but no MFA factor is documented, and the actual sign-in and identity-proofing flow on the application host was not observed. Missing for 10: documented MFA on sign-in, explicit confirmation that no identity-proofing step (biometric, in-person, or mailed PIN) is required, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the sign-in flow.
